high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website wired.com, viewed on a mobile device. The time displayed at the top of the screen is 7:58, and the device is connected to a 5G network with a partially charged battery. The article discusses a marathon writing session involving Steve Jobs, working with Laurene Hawley. Hawley advised Jobs to print out the speech, squint at it, and practice reading it aloud. She suggested that Jobs should walk down the street and read the speech to a tree a few times to become comfortable with the page turns or any other transitions. For the next few days
